title: Guitar
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Guitar body: warm orange upper/lower bouts -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='27' ry='23' fill='#f5a623'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='27' ry='23' fill='none' stroke='#ffd27a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- inner accent -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='17' ry='14' fill='#e08600'/>
  <!-- sound hole -->
  <circle cx='49' cy='66' r='8' fill='#5a2d00'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='66' r='8' fill='none' stroke='#b5651d' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- rosette ring -->
  <circle cx='49' cy='66' r='10.5' fill='none' stroke='#ffd27a' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='46' y='20' width='8' height='30' fill='#a5643a'/>
  <rect x='46' y='20' width='3' height='30' fill='#c98a5c'/>
  <!-- frets -->
  <rect x='46' y='26' width='8' height='1.2' fill='#e8c9a0'/>
  <rect x='46' y='32' width='8' height='1.2' fill='#e8c9a0'/>
  <rect x='46' y='38' width='8' height='1.2' fill='#e8c9a0'/>
  <rect x='46' y='44' width='8' height='1.2' fill='#e8c9a0'/>
  <!-- headstock -->
  <rect x='44' y='8' width='12' height='13' rx='2' fill='#8a4f2b'/>
  <rect x='44' y='8' width='4' height='13' rx='2' fill='#a86a44'/>
  <!-- tuning pegs -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='12' r='2' fill='#f0e0b0'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='17' r='2' fill='#f0e0b0'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='12' r='2' fill='#f0e0b0'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='17' r='2' fill='#f0e0b0'/>
  <!-- strings -->
  <rect x='48' y='21' width='0.7' height='37' fill='#fff4d6'/>
  <rect x='50' y='21' width='0.7' height='37' fill='#fff4d6'/>
  <rect x='52' y='21' width='0.7' height='37' fill='#fff4d6'/>
  <!-- bridge -->
  <rect x='42' y='76' width='16' height='4' rx='1' fill='#6b3a12'/>
  <rect x='42' y='76' width='16' height='1.5' rx='1' fill='#9a5a28'/>
</svg>
